_comment: Colour of every material name used in public/models/*.glb. Colours are the filament colours stored in 'Factory Speghetti AMS.3mf' (Metadata/project_settings.config, filament_colour; 'filament' is the 1-based slot number). The converter warns if the file's colour for that slot no longer matches. 'player' is tinted at runtime with the owner's colour; its colour here is a neutral placeholder (the file's slot 4 colour is #71D0FF).
